raw_segments.text: Anne, foul devil, for God's sake hence and trouble us not, for thou hast made the happy
earth thy hell, filled it with cursing cries and deep exclaims.
If thou delight to view thy heinous deeds, behold this pattern of thy butcheries.
O gentlemen, see, see dead Henry's wounds open their congealed mouths and bleed afresh.
Blush, blush, thou lump of foul deformity, for tease thy presence that exhales this blood
from cold and empty veins where no blood dwells.
Thy deeds, inhuman and unnatural, provokes this deluge most unnatural.
O God, which this blood madstee revenges death.
O earth, which this blood drinkstee revenges death.
Either heaven with lightning strike the murderer dead, or earth gape open wide and eat him
quick, as thou dost swallow up this good king's blood, which his hell-governed arm hath butchered.
